# STC Mitra LLC

Official website: https://stc-mitra.com/

STC Mitra is a structural engineering company providing structural design, independent verification, building surveys, design audit, strengthening, geotechnical analysis and construction-stage support.

The team developed between 2019 and 2024 as the in-house calculation centre and technical directorate of PIK Group. STC Mitra LLC was established as an independent company in December 2024.

The practical knowledge base includes more than 1,700 resolved construction defects and complex engineering issues. The independent portfolio for January 2025–June 2026 includes 67 contracted work packages for 22 clients; 12 clients returned with new assignments and 85% of the portfolio came from repeat engagements.

## Markets and standards

STC Mitra is expanding its international delivery base into Uzbekistan. Work can be performed under the agreed ACI, EN/Eurocode or SP framework, subject to project requirements and local approval rules.

## Core services

- Structural design for reinforced-concrete and steel structures.
- Independent verification and special structural calculations.
- Surveys and condition assessment of buildings and structures.
- Audit of structural design and construction documentation.
- Construction-stage support for defects, deviations and design errors.
- Repair and strengthening design.
- Foundation, pile, settlement and soil-structure interaction analysis.
- R&D, testing and verification of calculation models.

## Calculation capabilities

- Nonlinear structural analysis with geometric and material nonlinearity.
- Global-to-local finite-element modelling of connections, anchorage and damaged zones.
- Local checks of plates, welds, bolts, anchors, bearing and contact behaviour.
- Thermal stress states, restraint effects and temperature gradients.
- Construction-stage, stiffness-evolution and time-dependent analysis.
- Seismic and dynamic actions.
- Progressive collapse and robustness.
- Fire scenarios.
- Precast systems and connection flexibility.
- Soil-foundation-superstructure interaction.
